description: Sample fixed-width single-record mapping for the BA-facing template. Worked example: a flat DDA-style accounts export with one record type per line (80-char rows). Mirrors the field-spec shape used by config/mappings/SHAW_TRANERT_BATCH_HEADER_mapping.json -- each field carries 1-indexed position, length, data_type, and optional valid_values / format / required.

fields.name: ACCT_NUM
fields.description: Account number -- zero-padded numeric identifier (5 chars).

fields.name: ACCT_NAME
fields.description: Account holder name -- blank-padded right (20 chars).

fields.name: OPEN_DATE
fields.description: Account open date in MM/DD/CCYY format (10 chars including slashes).

fields.name: BALANCE
fields.description: Current balance -- zero-padded numeric (10 chars). The sample's row 8 carries non-numeric characters to exercise the format check.

fields.name: ACCT_STATUS
fields.description: Account status code. The sample's row 9 carries 'XX' to exercise the valid_values check.

fields.name: FILLER
fields.description: Reserved filler -- blanks to fill the 80-char width.
